blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Speech-capable language models inherit most of their knowledge from text-rich language backbones, and continued model maintenance is likewise dominated by text updates. Knowledge acquired through a text update can nevertheless remain difficult to access when the same query is spoken. We formulate this mismatch as post-update speech access repair, where the knowledge-bearing checkpoint stays frozen and a detachable operator repairs speech-only access in one model pass. We introduce Affine Fields for Interface Repair across Modalities (AFFIRM), which first learns and freezes a base correction for speech hidden states, then adds query-specific corrections with zero mean over the operator-training queries. Paired speech and text states provide the coordinates that condition these corrections on each query. On balanced synthetic-speech PopQA, paired comparisons do not establish a clear advantage for AFFIRM over global SALSA steering or low-rank ReFT interventions under the same frozen single-state constraint. On recorded SLUE-SQA-5 questions with text passages, a full-scale PopQA-fitted AFFIRM operator transfers without refitting and improves ROUGE-L by 0.0941 over its paired No Repair baseline. Low-rank ReFT interventions also transfer positively, whereas the matched SALSA variant falls 0.0707 below its paired baseline. These results show that text acquisition and speech access can diverge after an update and should be verified and repaired separately.
blocks.zh: 语音能力语言模型从丰富的文字语言骨干中继承大部分知识,持续的模型维护同样以文本更新为主. 然而,如果听到同样的查询,通过文本更新获得的知识仍然难以获取。 我们把这种不匹配发展成更新后的语音访问修复,即拥有知识的检查站仍然被冻结,以及一个模式的操作员只修复语音访问。 我们引入Affine Fields for Interface Reform over Everyways(AFFIRM),它首先学习并冻结语音隐藏状态的基础校正,然后在操作员培训查询上添加零平均值的查询特定校正. Paired 语音和文本状态提供坐标,以每个查询的更正为条件。 在平衡合成-声波PopQA上,配对比较并不能确定AFFIRM相对于全球SALSA方向或低级ReFT干预在相同的冷冻单态约束下的明显优势. 在有文字段落记录的SLUE-SQA-5问题上,一个全尺寸的PopQA适配的AFFIRM操作员在不进行调试的情况下,将ROUGE-L比其配对的无修基线改进0.0941. 低等级的ReFT干预也呈正向转移,而与之匹配的SALSA变体则低于其配对基线0.0707。 这些结果显示,文本获取和语音访问在更新后可能存在差异,应当单独核实和修复.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Large language models increasingly serve as the reasoning core of interactive systems that use tools and act on external environments ( Yao et al., 2023 ; Schick et al., 2023 ) .
Recent speech-language models extend this interaction from typed text to spoken input and output ( Tang et al., 2024 ; Hu et al., 2024 ; Xu et al., 2025 ; Shih et al., 2024 ) .
Most general-purpose training data and factual maintenance material for these systems still come from text: web pages, documents, code, and manuals are available at far larger scale than paired speech supervision ( Raffel et al., 2020 ; Gao et al., 2021 ; Wang et al., 2023 ) .
Speech-capable models therefore commonly attach audio encoders and alignment modules to a text-pretrained language backbone, while text remains the direct route for factual adaptation and targeted editing ( Tang et al., 2024 ; Hu et al., 2024 ; Xu et al., 2025 ; Meng et al., 2022 ; Meng et al., 2023 ) .
blocks.zh:
大型语言模型日益成为使用工具和对外部环境采取行动的互动系统的推理核心(姚等,2023;史克等,2023.).
近期的语音-语言模型将这种交互作用从打字文本扩展到口语输入和输出(Tang等,2024;Hu等,2024;徐等,2025;Shih等,2024.).
这些系统的多数通用培训数据和事实维护材料仍然出自文本:网页、文件、代码和手册的提供规模远大于配对语音监督(Raffel等,2020年;Gao等,2021年;Wang等,2023年)。
因此,语音能力模型通常会将音频编码器和对接模块附加到文本预选语言主干线上,而文本仍然是事实调整和定向编辑的直接途径(Tang等,2024;Hu等,2024;徐等,2025;Meng等,2022;Meng等,2023).

blocks.en:
Native multimodality does not by itself make every text update equally usable from speech.
Studies of speech-language models report differences between matched spoken and typed inputs in semantic understanding, reasoning, and factual-recall pathways ( Xiang et al., 2025 ; Cuervo et al., 2026 ; Modica et al., 2026 ; Hsu et al., 2026b ; Hsu et al., 2026c ) .
We study a post-update instance of this mismatch: after a successful text-only update, a model may answer an updated fact when the question is typed yet fail when the same question is spoken.
The correct text response shows that the acquired checkpoint can express the updated fact, while the paired speech failure defines the post-update speech-access gap that we repair.
blocks.zh:
本土多式性本身并不能使每一文本的更新从语音中平等使用。
对语言模型的研究报告了在语义理解、推理和事实召回途径方面对应的口语和打出的投入之间的差异(Xiang等,2025;Cuervo等,2026;Modica等,2026;Hsu等,2026b;Hsu等,2026c.).
我们研究了这一不匹配的更新后实例:在仅对文本进行成功的更新后,当问题被输入而在同一问题被说出时失败时,模型可能会回答更新的事实.
正确的文本回复显示,已获得的检查站可以表达更新的事实,而配对的语音故障则定义了我们所修复的更新后语音-访问漏洞.

blocks.en:
This problem arises whenever knowledge is maintained through text while users continue to query the resulting system by voice.
We consider a contract in which the acquired checkpoint is immutable and the repair remains detachable.
At deployment, the question is supplied only as speech, and the repair edits one decoder state in one model pass without a transcript.
The contract separates the knowledge-bearing checkpoint from the interface that makes its updated knowledge accessible (Figure 1 ).
blocks.zh:
每当通过文本维持知识,而用户继续通过语音查询所产生的系统时,就会产生这个问题。
我们认为,一项合同规定,购置的检查站是不可改变的,修理工作仍然是可拆卸的。
在部署时,问题仅作为语音提供,而修理则编辑一个型号通关中一个解码器状态而无记录.
合同将具有知识的检查点与使其最新知识能够进入的接口分开(图1)。

blocks.en:
The central design question is how to combine a base repair learned across speech queries with a correction tailored to each input.
We combine these roles in Affirm , or Affine Fields for Interface Repair across Modalities .
We first learn and freeze a base correction, called the shared access parent .
We then add a query-specific correction, called the centered route field , whose mean over the operator-training queries is zero.
Paired spoken and typed queries provide the hidden-state coordinates used to condition this correction.
blocks.zh:
中心设计问题是如何将从语音查询中汲取的基修与针对每个输入的校正结合起来.
我们把这些角色合并到Afward, 或Affine Fields 用于跨模式的界面修复。
我们首先学习并冻结一个基础校正, 叫做共享访问母。
然后我们添加一个特定查询的校正, 称为中心路由域,
Paired speak and typed series 提供了用来作为这一更正条件的隐藏状态坐标.

blocks.en:
The experiments first establish a large paired text–speech gap after successful text acquisition.
On balanced PopQA, paired bootstrap comparisons do not establish a clear advantage for Affirm-Direct over DiReFT, LoReFT, or SALSA.
When operators fitted on full-scale PopQA transfer without refitting to recorded SLUE questions, Affirm-Direct and ReFT improve over No Repair, whereas the matched SALSA variant degrades.
Parent comparisons and a two-seed depth sweep examine which design choices affect performance, and the compact variant also improves held-out access on Kimi-Audio.
blocks.zh:
实验在成功获取了文本后,首先确定了一个大对齐的文本-语法差距.
在平衡的PopQA中,配对的靴子比较并不能确定Afward-Direct相对于DireFT,LoReFT或SALSA的明显优势.

父母比较和双种子深度扫描检查哪些设计选择会影响性能,而紧凑的变体还改善了Kimi-Audio上的被搁置访问.

blocks.en: Our contributions are: • We formulate post-update speech access repair, separating text knowledge acquisition from detachable speech access through an immutable acquired checkpoint. • We introduce Affirm , a staged affine field that combines a shared access parent with a centered query-specific route field learned from paired speech–text routes. • We show that methods with comparable synthetic-speech performance can differ under recorded-speech transfer, where Affirm and ReFT improve over No Repair while the tested SALSA variant regresses.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Modern speech language models commonly connect an audio encoder to a pretrained text decoder through projectors, adapters, and staged multimodal training ( Tang et al., 2024 ; Hu et al., 2024 ; Xu et al., 2025 ; Hsu et al., 2026a ) .
Behavior alignment and cross-modal distillation train the speech route to reproduce capabilities available from text ( Wang et al., 2023 ; Wang et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2026b ; Hu et al., 2026 ; Cao et al., 2026 ) .
Speech inputs nevertheless remain weaker on some semantic and reasoning tasks, and representation similarity is associated with the remaining modality gap ( Xiang et al., 2025 ; Cuervo et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026a ) .
These studies improve speech during multimodal adaptation, whereas we address the later maintenance stage after a text update has established the target knowledge.
blocks.zh:
现代语音语言模型通常通过投影器,适配器将音频编码器与预训文本解码器相连接,并进行多模式培训(Tang等,2024;Hu等,2024;徐等,2025;Hsu等,2026a).
行为对接和跨模式蒸馏训练语音途径,以从文本中获取复制能力(王等,2023;王等,2024;王等,2026b;胡等,2026;曹等,2026).
然而,在某些语义和推理任务上,言论投入仍然较弱,代表性的相似性与剩余的模式差距有关(Xiang等,2025;Cuervo等,2026;Wang等,2026a)。
这些研究改进了多式联运改造期间的语音,而我们在文本更新确定目标知识后处理后来的维护阶段。

blocks.en:
Multimodal models can store or acquire information through one route without making it equally available from another ( Wen et al., 2025 ; Basu et al., 2024 ) .
Speech and text can also rely on distinct factual-recall pathways inside a shared multimodal model ( Modica et al., 2026 ) .
Knowledge-editing methods change stored associations in language and audio-language models ( Meng et al., 2022 ; Meng et al., 2023 ; Chung et al., 2026 ) .
Our task instead begins after acquisition succeeds and repairs the route by which a frozen checkpoint accesses the acquired fact.
blocks.zh:
多式联运模型可以通过一种途径存储或获取信息,而无需从另一种途径平等获取信息(Wen等人,2025;Basu等人,2024)。
发言和案文还可以依赖在共同的多式联运模式内不同的事实回顾途径(Modica等人,2026年)。
知识编辑方法改变了语言和音频模型中存储的关联(Meng等,2022;Meng等,2023;Chung等,2026)。
相反,我们的任务是在购置成功后开始的,并修复一个被冻结的检查站进入已获得事实的路线。

blocks.en:
A complementary line of work leaves pretrained model weights fixed and modifies behavior through narrow interventions on hidden representations.
Inference-Time Intervention learns directions at selected attention heads, while activation addition modifies residual-stream states with behavior-specific directions ( Li et al., 2023 ; Turner et al., 2023 ) .
ReFT generalizes learnable representation interventions at chosen layers and positions, including the DiReFT and LoReFT parameterizations ( Wu et al., 2024 ) .
These methods adapt behavior through a fixed text-model backbone, but they do not separate a text-acquisition stage from speech access to the acquired knowledge. Affirm brings this intervention family to post-update speech access by learning from paired speech–text routes and retaining a detachable repair around a frozen shared parent.
blocks.zh:
互补的一行工作留下了预先受训练的模型权重被固定并改变行为,通过对隐藏表述的狭义干预.
推论-时间干预在选定的注意力头学习方向,而活化添加则会改变有特定行为方向的残留流状态(Li等,2023;Turner等,2023.).
ReFT概括了在选定的层次和位置,包括DiReFT和LoReFT参数化(Wu等,2024年)的可学习的表述干预.
这些方法通过固定的文本模型主干线来适应行为,但它们并没有将文本获取阶段与语音访问与所获得知识相分离. 透过学习对等的语音文字路线,

blocks.en:
Learned speech steering can optimize shared layer-wise additive directions with a frozen backbone ( Yegorova et al., 2026 ) .
Input-dependent steering predicts an intervention from each multimodal context ( Parekh et al., 2025 ) , while Steer-MoE dynamically mixes expert directions inside audio-encoder layers ( Feng et al., 2025 ) .
Angle and length interventions provide another representation-level route for reducing the speech–text modality gap ( Xiang et al., 2025 ) .
Together, these approaches establish global and input-conditioned steering as complementary mechanisms for reducing speech–text discrepancies. Affirm addresses post-update factual access through a detachable operator that edits one decoder state of a frozen acquired checkpoint.

blocks.en: 4 Affirm : Shared Access Parent with Centered Route Field
blocks.zh: 4 申明: 拥有中心路段的共享访问父母

blocks.en: 4.1 Method overview
blocks.zh: 4.1 国家 方法概览

blocks.en:
Affirm decomposes post-update repair into a shared access parent and a query-conditioned route field around that parent.
We first learn a low-dimensional code that predicts the difference between matched text and speech prompt states, without answer labels.
Stage A trains the parent using answer supervision through the frozen decoder.
Stage B freezes the parent and the coordinate map, then trains only the readout that converts these codes into query-specific corrections.
The acquired checkpoint remains frozen throughout, and deployment stores only the compact operator.

blocks.en: 4.6 Fitting and deployment
blocks.zh: 4.6 配置和部署

blocks.en:
For the primary Qwen experiments, we select the block, overall strength α \alpha , and route-field coefficient β \beta on development data, then fix the operator before testing.
At inference, Affirm edits the final prompt state during prefill and then continues ordinary greedy generation without editing answer-token states.
It requires no question transcript, matched text-question state, pre-update checkpoint F θ 0 F_{\theta_{0}} , or external ASR system.
Appendix A gives the fitting schedules and inference settings for each variant.

推论,Affward在预填时会编辑最终的快取状态,然后继续普通的贪婪的生成而无需编辑解答状态.

blocks.en: 5 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 5 实验设置

blocks.en:
We use Qwen2.5-Omni-7B ( Xu et al., 2025 ) .
For full-scale experiments, we fine-tune one checkpoint on text question–answer pairs from all 14,267 PopQA facts over 16 relations ( Mallen et al., 2023 ) and another on all 4,000 TOFU questions over 200 fictional authors ( Maini et al., 2024 ) .
We then freeze each checkpoint and fit its repair operators.
We also evaluate compact operators on separately acquired Kimi-Audio-7B ( KimiTeam et al., 2025 ) and MiMo-Audio-7B ( Xiaomi LLM-Core Team, 2025 ) checkpoints (Appendix D.5 ).
blocks.zh:
我们使用Quen2.5-Omni-7B(徐等,2025.
对于全面的实验,我们微调了一个关于文本问题的检查点——来自所有14,267个PopQA事实的回答对(Mallen等人,2023年),另一个是针对超过200个虚构作者(Maini等人,2024年)的所有4000个TOFU问题。
然后,我们冻结每个检查站,并安装其修理操作员。
我们还对分别购置的Kimi-Audio-7B(KimiTeam等,2025年)和MiMo-Audio-7B(Xiaomi LLM-Core Team,2025年)检查站的紧凑操作员进行评估(附录D.5)。

blocks.en:
For PopQA, we group questions linked by a shared subject or normalized question string before splitting, so no group crosses the 8,572/2,848/2,847 operator train/development/test split.
PopQA-20 and PopQA-60 use nested subsets of 2,853 and 8,560 training examples, approximately 20% and 60% of the full acquisition corpus, with the same development and test sets.
TOFU uses 120/40/40 train/development/test authors, yielding 2,400/800/800 examples without author overlap.

对于"PopQA",我们在分拆前将一个共享主体或已规范的问题串连接起来的问题分组,因此没有分组跨越8,572/2,848/2,847号运营商列车/开发/测试分拆.
PopQA-20和PopQA-60使用由2,853个和8,560个训练实例组成的嵌入子集,约占全部获取指令的20%和60%,具有相同的开发与测试集.
TOFU使用120/40/40列车/开发/测试作者,产生2,400/800/800例,没有作者重叠.

blocks.en:
For the balanced PopQA comparison, we use a separate checkpoint acquired on 1,000 facts and a 600/199/201 operator train/development/test split that keeps duplicate questions together.
We separately fit each method on PopQA-20 for recorded-speech transfer and on TOFU training authors for author-disjoint evaluation.
Appendix B gives the implementation and development-selection details for every reproduced baseline.

我们分别将PopQA-20的每一种方法用于录相调试,并将TOFU的每个方法用于作者与不同步评价。

blocks.en:
The frozen-checkpoint comparison evaluates the following speech-only representation-level repair methods: • No Repair applies the acquired checkpoint to speech without an added intervention. • DiReFT and LoReFT ( Wu et al., 2024 ) learn low-rank hidden-state interventions at a selected decoder state. • L2S ( Parekh et al., 2025 ) predicts an input-dependent steering intervention from the multimodal context. • SALSA ( Yegorova et al., 2026 ) learns one shared speech-aware steering activation vector with a frozen backbone. All speech-only methods receive the question as audio, without its transcript or a paired text-question state, and use one pass through the frozen acquired checkpoint.
Speech LoRA ( Hu et al., 2022 ) , speech-to-text knowledge distillation ( Wang et al., 2026b , S2T-KD,) , a Whisper ASR cascade ( Radford et al., 2023 ) , and full speech supervision are reported separately as operational alternatives because they relax the frozen single-state deployment contract.

Speech LoRA (Hu等, 2022年), Speech-to-text 知识分馏 (Wang等, 2026b, S2T-KD, ),一款Whisper ASR级联(Radford等, 2023年), 完全的语音监督由于放松被冻结的单州部署合同,被单独报告为业务替代.

blocks.en:
CosyVoice renders the PopQA and TOFU questions used for fitting and evaluation ( Du et al., 2024 ) .
Our transfer evaluation uses all 256 recorded SLUE-SQA-5 questions from 50 human speakers and five source datasets ( Shon et al., 2023 ) .
Each SLUE input contains a text passage and a spoken question, so speech-only refers to the question modality.
We apply each frozen PopQA-20 operator with no SLUE training examples, refitting, or target-domain strength retuning.
The separate Angle and Length controls access the paired text question at inference.
This tests transfer to passage-based question answering under changes in task, prompt, speakers, and acoustics, rather than recall of the acquired PopQA facts.

blocks.en: 6.1 The text update leaves a measurable speech-access gap

blocks.en:
Text-only acquisition succeeds without making the acquired knowledge equally usable from speech.

The held-out PopQA and TOFU questions test access to facts included in text acquisition.
To test whether speech states retain question-specific information, we retrieve each speech state’s matching text state among 600 paired questions.
After subtracting each modality’s mean state, top-1 retrieval accuracy is 50.3%, compared with 0.17% chance (Appendix D ).

blocks.en: 8 Discussion and Conclusion
blocks.zh: 8 讨论和结论

blocks.en:
The experiments show that text acquisition and speech access can diverge after an update. Affirm implements speech-access repair as a detachable operator, combining a shared access parent with a smaller centered route field for query-specific variation.
This structure complements speech-pathway retraining when checkpoint immutability and one-pass speech inference matter.
blocks.zh:
实验显示,文本获取和语音访问在更新后可能会有差异. Afward作为可拆分的运算符执行语音访问修复,将共享访问母和较小的中心路由域结合,用于查询特定变异.
这一结构补充了检查站无法使用和单通语音推断时的语音-路径再培训。

blocks.en:
On balanced synthetic speech, paired comparisons do not establish a clear Affirm advantage over SALSA or ReFT.
Operators fitted separately on full-scale PopQA differ in transfer to recorded SLUE questions with text passages, where ReFT and Affirm improve over No Repair while the tested SALSA variant regresses.
blocks.zh:
在平衡合成语言方面,配对比较并不能确立比SALSA或ReFT明显具有的威力优势.
单独安装在全尺寸PopQA的操作员在转录SLUE问题与文本段落不同,ReFT和Afward比不修理改进,而测试的SALSA变体则倒退。

blocks.en:
With the centered route field included, the expert parent gives higher block-4 TOFU scores and the direct parent gives higher SLUE point estimates.
The compact TOFU sweep favors early decoder blocks.

包括了中心路由字段,专家家长给出了更高的块-4 TOFU分数,直接家长给出了更高的SLUE分数估计.

blocks.en: Knowledge can be acquired through the richest supervision route, and speech access can then be verified and repaired without modifying the acquired checkpoint.

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en:
We study short-answer factual access after text-only updates, primarily with Qwen2.5-Omni-7B.
Our PopQA and TOFU evaluations measure access to facts included in text acquisition, with disjoint operator-training, development, and test groups.
They therefore characterize transfer of the repair across acquired facts rather than acquisition of unseen knowledge.
The paired text–speech generation gap operationalizes access but does not localize every acoustic or internal cause.
blocks.zh:
我们研究在仅更新文本之后的短答事实访问,主要使用Quen2.5-Omni-7B.
我们的 " PopQA " 和 " TOFU " 评估衡量文本获取中包含的事实的获取情况,与操作者培训、开发和测试小组脱节。
因此,它们将修复的转移描述为跨越既得事实,而不是获取看不见的知识。
成对的文本 - speech 生成漏洞可操作访问,但不会将每一个声学或内部原因本地化.

blocks.en:
Our PopQA and TOFU experiments use synthetic English speech from one fixed voice.
Recorded SLUE extends the evaluation to human speech, but jointly changes the task, prompt, speakers, and acoustics.
It also supplies a text passage, so this evaluation measures no-refit behavior transfer rather than closed-book recall of newly acquired facts from human recordings.
The transfer result concerns the complete fitted operator and does not isolate the centered route field’s contribution.
blocks.zh:
我们的"PopQA"和"TOFU"实验使用一个固定声音的合成英语语音.
有录音的SLUE将评价扩展到了人类的演讲,但共同改变了任务,即时,扬声,和声.
它还提供了文本段落,因此这一评价衡量的是不适应行为转移,而不是对从人类录音中新获得的事实的封闭式召回.
转接结果涉及完全安装的操作员,并不孤立中心路由场的贡献.

blocks.en:
Kimi-Audio provides a locked-test evaluation of the compact realization, while MiMo-Audio gives mixed development results.
The single-state intervention restricts adaptation capacity, and broader speech fine-tuning or an ASR cascade can attain higher accuracy when the deployment contract is relaxed.
Long-form generation, multilingual access, repeated checkpoint updates, and architecture-specific scaling remain future directions.
blocks.zh:
Kimi-Audio为紧凑实现提供锁定测试评价,而MiMo-Audio给出了喜忧参半的发展成果.
单一状态干预限制了适应能力,在放宽部署合同时,更广泛的语音微调或自动识别系统级联可以达到更高的准确性。
长式生成,多语种接入,重复更新检查站,以及针对特定架构的缩放仍然是未来的方向.

blocks.en: Ethical Considerations
blocks.zh: 道德考虑

blocks.en:
Our experiments concern access to factual information through spoken queries.
Improved access can make voice interfaces more useful, but an intervention can also change a previously correct answer or expose incorrect information stored by the model.
Aggregate benchmark gains do not establish reliability for consequential applications.
The English synthetic-speech and recorded-speech evaluations leave performance across languages, accents, and user groups incompletely characterized.
Use of the models and speech datasets remains subject to their respective licenses and usage conditions.
blocks.zh:
我们的实验涉及通过口头询问获取事实信息。
改进访问可以使语音界面更有用,但一次干预也可以改变之前正确的答案或暴露模型所存储的不正确信息.
合计基准收益不能确定相应应用的可靠性。
英文的合成-口音和录音-口音评价在语言、口音和用户群体之间留下了不完全的特征。
模型和语音数据集的使用仍须遵守各自的许可证和使用条件。

blocks.en: A.2 Acquired checkpoints and prompts

blocks.en:
Text acquisition updates all Qwen2.5-Omni-7B parameters for ten epochs on the corresponding text QA corpus.
It uses batch size one with four-step gradient accumulation, maximum sequence length 500, learning rate 2 × 10 − 5 2\times 10^{-5} , zero weight decay, a 0.03 warm-up ratio, and gradient-norm clipping at 1.
The balanced and full PopQA acquisitions are separate checkpoints, and TOFU uses its own acquired checkpoint.
Every access operator is fitted only after acquisition, and the acquired checkpoint remains frozen during operator fitting and evaluation.

每个接入操作员都是在购置后安装的,在操作员安装和评价期间,已购置的检查站仍然被冻结。

blocks.en:
Text questions use a plain question-answer prompt, while speech questions use the model’s native audio wrapper with the same answer target.
The SLUE prompt contains a text passage followed by a recorded speech question under Qwen’s standard multimodal system prompt.
No automatic transcript or text version of the spoken question is inserted for speech-only methods.
The five SLUE source datasets change both the linguistic task mixture and the prompt structure relative to short PopQA questions.

五个SLUE源数据集既会改变语言任务混合物,也会改变相对于短波普QA问题的即时结构.

blocks.en: A.4 Frozen inference calibration

blocks.en:
We fix all intervention strengths before test evaluation.
Equal alpha values do not imply equal interventions across a norm-preserving vector and an affine field.
We therefore compare learned operators through realized mean edit norms rather than raw alphas.
The fixed Affirm-Direct alphas are 0.447348 on PopQA-20, 0.429581 on PopQA-60, and 0.289593 on TOFU.

因此,我们通过实现的平均编辑规范,而不是原始的α来比较有学问的操作员。

blocks.en: A.5 Decoding, metrics, uncertainty, and failures
blocks.zh: A.5 解码、计量、不确定性和故障

blocks.en:
Evaluation uses greedy decoding with at most 160 new tokens on PopQA and TOFU and at most 64 new tokens on SLUE.
ROUGE-L is the recall form of the longest-common-subsequence score against the reference answer.
Exact match lowercases text, strips punctuation and articles, normalizes whitespace, and then tests equality.
SLUE answer-span accuracy credits a generation when its normalized text contains the normalized short reference answer.
Retention divides the number of no-repair-correct items that remain exact under intervention by the total number of no-repair-correct items.

blocks.en: D.1 Synthesized-question content retention

blocks.en:
To test whether synthetic-speech states preserve question-specific content, we analyze the 600 paired text and CosyVoice speech prompt-final states captured for Affirm fitting at block 20.
After subtracting the route-specific population mean, speech-to-text exact-pair retrieval reaches 0.5033 top-1, 0.6967 top-5, and 0.5979 mean reciprocal rank over all 600 candidates.
Global top-1 chance is 0.0017.
When candidates are restricted to the same PopQA relation, top-1 remains 0.5033 while item-averaged chance is 0.0267 with a median of 52 candidates.
The reverse text-to-speech direction gives 0.5183 global and 0.5200 within-relation top-1.
These results show that the internal speech state preserves substantial item-specific question identity rather than only the relation template.
They rule out total loss of question identity as a sufficient explanation but do not isolate the cause of the remaining generation gap.
blocks.zh:
为了检验合成语态是否保留特定的问题内容,我们分析了600对文本和CosyVoice的语音即时最终状态,它们被俘获于20号区块Affward。
在减去特定路线的人口平均值后,语音对正版检索达到0.5033个上行-1,0.6967个上行-5,而0.5979则意味着在所有600名候选人中对应排名.
全球第一机会为0.0017.
当候选人被限制在同一个PopQA关系时,前1位仍为0.5033,而项目平均机会为0.0267,中位数为52名候选人.
反向的文本对语音方向给出了0.5183个全局和0.5200个关系内部上行-1.
这些结果表明,内部语音状态保留了实质性的针对特定项目的问题身份,而不仅仅是关系模板.
他们排除了完全丧失问题身份作为充分解释,但并不孤立剩余生成差距的原因.

blocks.en: D.4 Compact-parent depth characterization

blocks.en:
We evaluate Affirm-K1 across decoder blocks using two training seeds and 800 TOFU development items, as summarized in Section 7 .
The split, K = 1 K=1 parent parameterization, local coefficient, and target edit norm are fixed across blocks 4 through 28.

正如第7节所总结的那样,我们利用两个培训种子和800个TOFU开发项目,在解码器区对Afward-K1进行评价。
拆分,K = 1 K = 1 母参数化,局部系数,以及目标编辑规范被固定在4至28个区块上.

blocks.en:
Mean full-field RL declines from 0.5550 at block 4 to 0.4788 at block 28.
The route field changes RL by at most 0.0068 at any block and seed, its two-seed average never exceeds 0.0025, and its sign varies across blocks and seeds.
The parent alone also peaks at block 4 in both seeds, so the route field does not determine the selected site.
blocks.zh:
平均全场RL从第4区0.5550降至第28区0.4788。
路由场在任何块和种子上最多会改变0.0068个RL,其双籽平均不超过0.0025个,其标志也因块和种子而异.

blocks.en:
We evaluate the selected Kimi operator on a separate test set.

我们通过一个单独的测试集来评估选定的Kimi操作员。

blocks.en: D.6 Geometric and capacity controls
blocks.zh: D.6 几何和能力控制

blocks.en:
To assess query-dependent geometry and model capacity, we compare a constant route mean, an answer-free low-rank route map, and a high-capacity kernel regressor on balanced PopQA (Table 15 ).
All nonzero edits operate at block 20 and use the same speech-only deployment interface.
blocks.zh:
为了评估依赖查询的几何和模型容量,我们比较一个恒定的路由平均值,一个无答的低阶路由图,和一个在平衡的PopQA上的高容量内核递归器(表15.
所有非零编辑在20区运行,并使用相同的只使用语音的部署接口.

blocks.en: Table 15: Representation controls on the 201-item balanced PopQA test. The mean edit norms are 22.51 for the controls and 22.62 for Affirm-Direct .
blocks.zh: 表15:201项目平衡PopQA测试的显示控制. 平均编辑规范是22.51个控件,22.62个是Afward-Direct。

blocks.en:
The route map achieves higher RL and EM than the mean shift on balanced PopQA.
Residual KRR stores 9.4 times more learned values than the route map but does not improve its test scores.
The remaining Affirm-Direct gap is consistent with decoder-facing training contributing beyond representation-only mapping.
blocks.zh:
路由图实现了比平衡PopQA上的平移更高的RL和EM.
残留的KRR存储的所学值是路由图的9.4倍,但并没有改善其测试分数.
其余的Afward-Direct缺口与解码器辅助培训相一致,这种培训不仅有助于绘制代表图。

blocks.en: Appendix E Comparison with Speech Fine-Tuning and ASR
blocks.zh: 附录E 与发言精细和ASR的比较

blocks.en: We compare external repair operators with alternatives that update model parameters or add an ASR pass.
blocks.zh: 我们比较了外部修理操作员与更新模型参数或添加ASR通口的替代品.

blocks.en: E.1 Matched-data direct speech fine-tuning
blocks.zh: E.1 匹配数据直接语音微调

blocks.en:
Table 16 summarizes a development comparison between a decoder-trained route map and direct Speech LoRA.
The four data budgets use nested training subsets and the same 199-item development set.
We evaluate this sweep only on development data.
The route map first fits rank-64 paired-state geometry for 1,000 steps, then updates its readout for one epoch at learning rate 0.001 while retaining the empirical mean route difference.
Its selective distillation uses the text route as the correction teacher and the unmodified speech route as the preservation teacher.
This variant has no separately trained access parent, so its resource measurements describe the route map rather than the staged Affirm procedure in Section 4 .
We calibrate its intervention strength without answer scores to the same mean edit norm at every budget.
Speech LoRA uses rank-16 adapters in all 28 decoder blocks and a common five-epoch cosine schedule.
For each Speech LoRA budget, the table reports the development checkpoint selected by RL with EM as the tie-breaker.
blocks.zh:
表16汇总了解码器所训练的路由图和直接Speech LoRA之间的发展比较.
四个数据预算使用嵌入式培训子集和相同的199项开发集.
我们只根据发展数据来评估这次调查。
路由图首先符合平分-64对等状态几何学的1000步,再以0.001的学习速率更新其读出一个纪元,同时保留经验平均路由差.
其有选择地分馏使用文本路由作为校正教师,未修改的语音路由作为保存教师.
这个变体没有经过单独训练的存取母,因此其资源测量描述的是路由图,而不是第4节中已上演的Afward程序.
我们调整其干预力量,而不回答每个预算的相同平均编辑标准。
Speech LoRA在所有28个解码器区块中都使用等级为16的适配器,并使用常见的5个纪元同位素表.
对于每个Speech LORA预算,表格报告RL选择的以EM为解绑符的开发检查站.

blocks.en:
Table 16: Matched-data development comparison of a decoder-trained route map and Speech LoRA. The route map uses the empirical mean route difference in place of Affirm ’s trained access parent and the unmodified speech output as its preservation target.
Its learned-value count includes both projection matrices and the empirical mean route difference.
Time is standalone end-to-end training time in seconds and excludes development generation.
Speech LoRA checkpoint times are reconstructed from checkpoint timestamps and stored full-run duration, so they are approximate.
blocks.zh:
表16:解码器所训练的路由图和Speech LoRA的匹配数据开发比较. 路由图使用经验平均路由差来取而代之的是Afward训练有素的访问母体和未修改的语音输出作为其保存目标.
其所学价值计算既包括预测矩阵,也包括经验平均路由差.
时间是数秒内独立的端到端培训时间,不包括开发生成.
语音LORA检查站时间由检查站时间戳重建并存储全程,因此大致相同.

blocks.en:
After selecting among five development checkpoints, Speech LoRA is at least as accurate at every unique-pair budget.
At 150 pairs and approximately matched wall time, the route map reaches 0.5720/0.5628 RL/EM in 202.6 seconds, while the first Speech LoRA epoch reaches 0.5695/0.5578 in 197.8 seconds.
The route map stores fewer learned values, while Speech LoRA uses less peak training memory at every budget and trains faster at the largest budget.
blocks.zh:
在从五个发展检查站中挑选之后,Speech LoRA在每个独特的预算中至少是准确的。
在150对和大约相匹配的墙上时间,行进图在202.6秒后达到0.5720/0.5628 RL/EM,而第一个Speech LoRA Epoch在197.8秒后达到0.5695/0.5578.
路由图存储了较少的所学价值,而Speech LORA在每个预算使用较少的峰值训练内存,在最大预算使用更快的训练.

blocks.en: E.2 Test accuracy and deployment requirements
blocks.zh: E.2 联合国 测试准确性和部署要求

blocks.en: Table 17 compares test accuracy and deployment requirements on balanced PopQA, PopQA-60, and TOFU.
blocks.zh: 表17比较了平衡的PopQA、PopQA-60和TOFU的测试准确性和部署要求。

blocks.en:
Table 17: Accuracy and mutability across frozen and relaxed deployment contracts. All scores are computed on the full test splits.
Speech LoRA and S2T-KD insert rank-16 adapters throughout all 28 decoder blocks, and S2T-KD adds a temperature-2 forward-KL term with weight 0.5 toward the text-route output distribution.
The ASR cascade transcribes each spoken question with Whisper-large-v3 and answers the transcript with the acquired checkpoint.
blocks.zh:
表17:冻结和放宽的部署合同的准确性和可变性。 所有分数都按测试分数计算。
Speech LoRA和S2T-KD在所有28个解码器区块中都插入了等级为16的适配器,而S2T-KD在文本路由输出分布上增加了一个有重量0.5的温度-2前置-KL名词.
ASR级联转录了Whisper-major-v3的每个口头问题,并在获得的检查站回答记录。

blocks.en: Broader adaptation and extra inference resources can reach higher accuracy than the detachable one-state operator.
blocks.zh: 更宽的适应和外推资源可以达到比可拆分的一态操作器更高的精度.
